properties.name: dashboard

properties.name: reports
properties.description: Supplies the report-list tab presentation.

properties.name: settings
properties.description: Supplies the settings tab presentation.

properties.name: detail
properties.description: Supplies a parameter-aware title for one report-detail tab.

properties.name: describeDemoDestination
properties.description: Creates a host-owned public tab descriptor from a page-instance ID and destination. @param id - Immutable page-instance identity selected by the host. @param destination - Canonical shell destination whose key selects tab presentation. @returns The complete descriptor supplied to the shell navigation adapter. @throws When the destination key is outside the demo route registry.

properties.name: vite.config
properties.description: Selects demo-specific Vite resolution for the invoked command. @param command The Vite command being executed. @returns Source aliases and workspace filesystem access only for development.

properties.name: defineAdminRouteUrlCodec
properties.description: Defines one codec while inferring method payload types from its schema. @param payloadSchema - Zod schema owning payload validation and normalization. @param codec - Encode/decode methods contextually typed from the supplied schema. @returns A complete route codec ready for a registry definition.

properties.name: defineAdminRouteRegistry
properties.description: Binds host route definitions to reversible AdminShell destination conversion. @param definitions - Name-free host route records keyed by stable nav-key identity. @returns One immutable registry API bound to the supplied definitions.

properties.name: getDefinition
properties.description: Resolves a definition or reports the invalid host destination key clearly.

properties.name: toLocation
properties.description: Converts one destination to its generated named Vue Router location.

properties.name: fromRoute
properties.description: Reconstructs one canonical destination from route and history state.

properties.name: toRouteRecords
properties.description: Derives named host route records from stable registry keys.

properties.name: createAdminShellVueRouterNavigation
properties.description: Coordinates AdminShell page instances with an existing Vue Router. @param options - Router, registry, and host-owned identity/presentation callbacks. @returns A stable navigation adapter backed by current route and history state.

properties.name: readPersistedState
properties.description: Reads and validates adapter metadata from the current navigation scope.

properties.name: fallbackEntryKey
properties.description: Derives stable identity for one unstamped browser-history entry.

properties.name: currentDescriptor
properties.description: Resolves the current canonical descriptor from router and history authority.

properties.name: descriptorForRequest
properties.description: Converts one shell request into the exact descriptor that must become active.

properties.name: toScopedLocation
properties.description: Builds one destination with adapter metadata for the current scope.

properties.name: navigateToDescriptor
properties.description: Persists one scoped descriptor through Vue Router.

properties.name: active
properties.description: Returns the descriptor reconstructed from current router authority.

properties.name: handleNavigation
properties.description: Executes open, activate, and close requests through one router effect.

properties.name: createPage
properties.description: Creates a route component suitable for navigation tests.

properties.name: createRegistry
properties.description: Creates the registry used to test URL and history-state composition.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Encodes identity in URL and section in host-owned history state.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Decodes URL identity and host-owned section state.

properties.name: describeDestination
properties.description: Creates deterministic host presentation for one destination.

properties.name: createHarness
properties.description: Creates a ready memory router and its navigation adapter.

properties.name: createPageId
properties.description: Returns a deterministic page ID for direct unstamped entries.

properties.name: getNavigationScopeId
properties.description: Returns the deterministic authenticated navigation scope under test.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Deliberately emits the adapter-reserved state key.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Decodes an empty payload for the collision fixture.

properties.name: createPage
properties.description: Creates a route component suitable for registry tests without application behavior.

properties.name: resolveRoute
properties.description: Creates a real normalized route from the supplied registry.

properties.name: createRegistry
properties.description: Creates the standard registry covering parameterless and payload-bearing routes.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Maps canonical report payload into the route path.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Reconstructs raw report payload from the normalized route path.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Stores canonical section data in history state.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Reads raw section data from history state.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Splits canonical payload between URL and history state.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Reconstructs payload with URL report identity and history-owned section precedence.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Emits optional payload as query state when supplied.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Returns optional raw payload from the current query.

properties.name: App
properties.description: Renders the frontend-only demo by composing application state with public admin APIs.

properties.name: theme
properties.description: Resolves the shell theme from the public preference without adding a parallel theme store.

properties.name: updateSystemTheme
properties.description: Synchronizes system-theme state after the browser color-scheme preference changes. @param event - The media-query change event reporting the current dark-mode match. @returns Nothing after updating the reactive system-theme state.

properties.name: stopSystemThemeListener
properties.description: Removes the browser media-query listener when the demo root unmounts. @returns Nothing after releasing the system-theme listener.

properties.name: themeOverrides
properties.description: Resolves the Naive font override from the public preference store's bounded font-size value.

properties.name: removeHistoryScopeGuard
properties.description: Replaces protected history entries that do not belong to the current auth scope.

properties.name: navigateHome
properties.description: Replaces the current route with this auth scope's Dashboard page instance.

properties.name: login
properties.description: Accepts only trimmed non-empty credentials and promotes local auth state without I/O. @param values - Frontend form values supplied by the packaged login UI. @returns A promise that resolves after local home-route navigation completes.

properties.name: logout
properties.description: Returns to the local home route and clears authentication without retaining a session. @returns A promise that resolves after local home-route navigation completes.

properties.name: createMenuOption
properties.description: Creates one plain Naive UI menu option while preserving host-owned nav-key identity. @param navKey - Stable application destination key. @param label - Visible menu label. @returns One unchanged Naive UI menu option.

properties.name: createDemoPage
properties.description: Renders a concise demonstration page with a semantic title and explanatory copy. @param title - The page heading and basis for the local component name. @param description - The user-facing explanation rendered beneath the heading. @returns A local Vue route component that renders the supplied page content.

properties.name: ReportsDemoPage
properties.description: Renders the reports page with an application-owned detail navigation trigger.

properties.name: openDetail
properties.description: Opens a new detail page instance even when the same destination is already open.

properties.name: DetailDemoPage
properties.description: Renders the non-menu detail route reached through an application-owned button.

properties.name: encode
properties.description: Maps the validated report identity to the detail route path parameter.

properties.name: decode
properties.description: Reconstructs raw report-detail payload from the normalized detail URL.

properties.name: renderLogoutIcon
properties.description: Renders the Vicons glyph that distinguishes the account menu's logout action.

properties.name: useAdminShell
properties.description: Resolves the public navigation control supplied by the nearest ancestor AdminShell. @returns The nearest shell's destination control. @throws When the caller is not rendered beneath an AdminShell provider.

properties.name: snapshotTab
properties.description: Returns a public immutable snapshot without shell-private mutable fields.

properties.name: AdminShell
properties.description: Renders the frontend-only authenticated shell and its runtime-owned controls.

properties.name: AdminShell
properties.description: Renders the frontend-only authenticated shell and its runtime-owned controls.

properties.name: reindexTabs
properties.description: Synchronizes retained tab indexes with visible order.

properties.name: clearTabs
properties.description: Clears ephemeral membership and invalidates an uncommitted candidate.

properties.name: recordCurrentTab
properties.description: Records or refreshes one host-confirmed descriptor by page-instance ID.

properties.name: openedDescriptors
properties.description: Returns all committed public descriptors in visible order.

properties.name: canActivateTab
properties.description: Returns whether Naive UI may activate a known idle page instance.

properties.name: activateTab
properties.description: Requests activation for one exact committed page instance.

properties.name: requestDestination
properties.description: Resolves a destination with an optional call policy and requests activation or open. @param destination - Durable router-neutral data retained when a new tab is committed. @param resolveTabNavigation - Ephemeral policy invoked only for this navigation call. @returns A promise that settles after resolution and any host navigation complete.

properties.name: getCloseDestination
properties.description: Computes the current-order fallback descriptor for an exact close request.

properties.name: closeTab
properties.description: Requests closure and removes only the exact record that owned the completion.

properties.name: toggleThemeMode
properties.description: Toggles between dark and non-dark presentation without opening a menu. Dark mode exits to explicit light mode; light and system modes enter dark mode. @returns Nothing after forwarding the next theme mode to the preference store.

properties.name: setFontSize
properties.description: Updates the font-size preference from a Naive dropdown option key. @param value - Selected dropdown key, which may be a string or number. @returns Nothing after forwarding a valid font size to the preference store.

properties.name: setLocale
properties.description: Updates the locale preference from a Naive dropdown option key. @param value - Selected dropdown key, which may be a string or number. @returns Nothing after forwarding a string locale key to the preference store.

properties.name: setSidebarCollapsed
properties.description: Sets sidebar collapse through the public preference store action. @param value - Whether the layout sidebar should render collapsed. @returns Nothing after storing the controlled ProLayout state.

properties.name: selectAccountAction
properties.description: Delegates the logout menu choice to the supplied frontend action without overlap. @param value - Selected dropdown key, which may be a string or number. @returns A promise that settles after recording any safe local failure feedback.

properties.name: ShellContextConsumer
properties.description: Exercises descendant access to the nearest provided AdminShell context.

properties.name: cleanMountedApps
properties.description: Unmounts every mounted application and clears the happy-dom document. @returns Nothing after test-owned browser state is removed.

properties.name: mountShell
properties.description: Mounts AdminShell with an initialized Pinia store and caller-owned synthetic slots, so each test can observe only the intended public content seam. @param authStatus - Frontend auth state supplied to the shell. @param authActions - Starter-owned login/logout callbacks. @param options - Optional opaque menu, navigation adapter, and synthetic slots. @returns The mounted application container.

properties.name: createAuthActions
properties.description: Creates the minimal frontend-only auth callback contract used by shell tests. @returns Login and logout spies with no backend coupling.

properties.name: settle
properties.description: Flushes promise continuations and Vue rendering after an async UI action. @returns A promise that resolves after the observable DOM is up to date.

properties.name: getTabClose
properties.description: Finds the close control rendered by a closable Naive UI tab. @param container - Mounted shell DOM containing the tab strip. @param key - Stable local tab key whose close control is needed. @returns The native `NTabs` close control, or null for a nonclosable tab.

properties.name: selectDropdownOption
properties.description: Opens a hover-triggered Naive dropdown and selects one visible popup-layer option. @param trigger - The button that owns the dropdown to open. @param label - The exact label of the option to select. @returns A promise that resolves after option selection and Vue rendering settle.
